shortDescription: Create destination volumes and transfer source data.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: How long should the socket layer wait before timing out for API calls. If this is omitted, nothing will be passed to the requests library.

options.name: auth
options.description: Required if 'cloud' param not used

options.name: auth_type
options.description: Auth type plugin for destination OpenStack cloud. Can be omitted if using password authentication.

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: A path to a CA Cert bundle that can be used as part of verifying SSL API requests.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: A path to a client certificate to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: client_key
options.description: A path to a client key to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Cloud resource from clouds.yml Required if 'auth' param not used

options.name: conversion_host
options.description: Dictionary with information about the destination conversion host (address, status, name, id)

options.name: dst_conversion_host_address
options.description: Optional IP address of the destination conversion host. Without this, the plugin will use the 'access_ipv4' property of the conversion host instance.

options.name: interface
options.description: Endpoint URL type to fetch from the service catalog.

options.name: log_file
options.description: Path to store a log file for this conversion process.

options.name: region_name
options.description: Name of the region.

options.name: sdk_log_level
options.description: Log level of the OpenStackSDK

options.name: sdk_log_path
options.description: Path to the logfile of the OpenStackSDK. If empty no log is written

options.name: src_conversion_host_address
options.description: Require IP address of the source conversion host. This is used by the destination conversion host to initiate data transfer.

options.name: ssh_key_path
options.description: Path to an SSH private key authorized on the destination cloud.

options.name: ssh_user
options.description: The SSH user to connect to the conversion hosts. Provided by the import_volumes_export_volumes module.

options.name: state_file
options.description: Path to store a transfer progress file for this conversion process.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout for long running operations, in seconds.

options.name: transfer_uuid
options.description: A UUID used to keep track of this tranfer's resources on the conversion hosts. Provided by the import_volumes_export_volumes module.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate HTTPS certificates when logging in to OpenStack.

options.name: volume_map
options.description: Dictionary providing information about the volumes to transfer. Provided by the import_volumes_export_volumes module.

options.name: wait
options.description: Should ansible wait until the requested resource is complete.
